question: Do the Venetian one-day events allow a re-entry or an add-on?
status: Open - blocks the label, not the schedule work
what_we_know: Single-entry is the point of the trip and no sheet in the series says either way.
how_to_find_it: Ask the Venetian poker desk for the written re-entry/add-on rule for the event numbers you plan to play (702.414.7657 / lv_cas_poker@venetianlasvegas.com on the official suite-rate page). Add the answer to structure_sheets.json as a source excerpt; the site then moves the row to 'Confirmed'.

question: Which dates is the trip, and how many nights?
what_we_know: Rates, availability, the day plan and the trip-cost total all depend on the dates. The site uses the official series window Nov 16 - Dec 23, 2026 and one worked example stay, Dec 2-9, 2026.
how_to_find_it: Confirm the arrival and departure dates; every rate figure is dated and must be re-read for the chosen window before it is used as a cost.

question: Is the $119 'as low as' poker-suite rate available for those nights?
what_we_know: It is the only official room-rate figure for the host property and it drives the trip-cost estimate; the logged booking-UI snapshot for the same week is about $1,008 per night, i.e. a different order of magnitude.
how_to_find_it: Call 866.255.8936 quoting code EPOKR25 (both printed on the official page) and confirm the qualifying-play requirement is met each night.

question: Is the room tax charged on the resort fee as well as the rate?
what_we_know: True nightly cost = rate + fee + tax; 'plus tax' on the fee changes the arithmetic by roughly $7 per night at the $55 fee.
how_to_find_it: Compare the itemised folio lines (room, resort fee, 13.38% tax) with the calculator's assumption once a quote exists.

question: How long does each event actually run?
what_we_know: 'Play all day from 8 AM' only works if an early event finishes before the next one starts.
how_to_find_it: No official end time exists. The site uses the published late-registration close and flags pairs whose windows cannot both be entered; ask the room for a typical finish for the events you pick.

question: Is there an 8:00 AM tournament start anywhere on the Strip?
what_we_know: The brief asks for an all-day schedule from 8 AM.
how_to_find_it: Re-reading the official pages on 2026-11-17: the earliest Venetian start is 9:10 AM (event #46 satellite, Fri Dec 12) and most early events start 10:10 or 11:10 AM; the earliest WPT start is 10:00 AM (Super Gold Million Day 1A). No official 8:00 AM start exists in these rooms, so the day plan is built from the earliest verified start instead.

question: Which hotel-to-venue walks are actually under 30 minutes?
what_we_know: The 30-minute limit is a hard filter in the brief and cost/quality are only compared inside it.
how_to_find_it: Time the route links on the Hotels page for the pairs that matter and record the minutes in walking.json; on-property routes are already verified at 0 minutes.

question: Do Wynn daily tournaments run during the WPT festival?
what_we_know: It decides whether a Wynn evening event can be a same-day fallback for a Venetian day.
how_to_find_it: The official Wynn page suspends dailies during the Wynn Signature, Wynn Millions and Classic series and says they run 'during non-event timeframes'; WPT is not named. Confirm with Wynn poker (702.770-7654 on the official WPT schedule PDF).

question: Is there an entry cap or a maximum field size?
what_we_know: A capped field changes what a guarantee means; the brief requires the total entry fee and the guarantee to be confirmed before ranking.
how_to_find_it: No sheet in the series publishes a cap - only payout percentages ('pays 12.5% of the field') and 'all pre-registered stacks in play' language. Ask per event number.

question: What exactly does the $10,400 WPT World Championship allow?
what_we_know: It is the festival's flagship event and the largest buy-in in the window.
how_to_find_it: Open the official WPT structures PDF at the World Championship terms and transcribe the Registration paragraph; until then the event is shown in the multi-entry section with the rule blank (F35).

question: Which hotel quality score should the ranking use?
what_we_know: Cost and quality outrank distance in the brief, but no property publishes a quality score.
how_to_find_it: Pick AAA diamond ratings or Forbes Travel Guide, and the site will store the rating with its date and URL. Without your choice the column stays blank (F44).

question: Should events whose sheet is silent stay in the main list?
what_we_know: 51 ranked rows carry every field verified except the entry rule; moving them to a watchlist would leave the main list empty for this series.
how_to_find_it: Decide: keep them labelled 'No entry rule stated' (current behaviour) or restrict the main list to confirmed rows only. Nothing is asserted about their entry rule either way.
